_about: v34: report limits per payment plan. reports_per_month = reports a business may create per calendar month (its own time zone; null = no limit). keep_per_user = how many of a person's created reports are kept in 'My reports' (oldest removed first). A business's plan is 'plan' in tenants.json (default_plan when missing). Counting rules: see README 'New in v34'. Validate with: python tools/check_report_blocks.py
